LESSON: BELIEF IN ANGELS ATID,

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.2: Belief in Angels Atid,

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Belief in Angels Atid,
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What are the duties of angels?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain the duties of the selected angels as a pillar of Iman
2. appreciate angels as Allah’s creation as a Pillar of Iman

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: explain the duties of the selected angels as a pillar of Iman

Teach
• Today’s focus: explain the duties of the selected angels as a pillar of Iman.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: appreciate angels as Allah’s creation as a Pillar of Iman

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate angels as Allah’s creation as a Pillar of Iman.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.

Try this

SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: explain the duties of the selected angels as a pillar of Iman
• Model 2: appreciate angels as Allah’s creation as a Pillar of Iman

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: explain the duties of the selected angels as a pillar of Iman
2. Practise: appreciate angels as Allah’s creation as a Pillar of Iman

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Belief in Angels Atid,.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are the duties of angels?
2. Why did Allah (S.W.T.) create angels?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• explain the duties of the selected angels as a pillar of Iman
• appreciate angels as Allah’s creation as a Pillar of Iman
